laws.rule: The Valencian Community does not charge a regional tourist tax. The tax on tourist stays created by Ley 7/2022 was repealed by Decreto-ley 12/2023 with effect from 15 November 2023, before anyone paid it; older pages may still describe it.
laws.heading: Ley 7/2022 de medidas fiscales para impulsar el turismo sostenible (repealed)

laws.rule: Camping in Valencian forest land requires permission from both the landowner and the competent regional authority, under the regulations.
laws.heading: Ley 3/1993, artículo 38

laws.rule: In Valencian forest land, motorised activities cross-country are prohibited except on authorised circuits.
laws.heading: Ley 3/1993, artículo 38

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.

sources.title: Ley Organica 5/1985 del Regimen Electoral General
sources.supports: fourth-Sunday-of-May rule for local and regional elections (read directly); the 2027 date is calculated from it
